name: Might
source:
Might is war orphan from the battle with Herdeus that occurred ten years prior, and grew up in an orphanage with his friend Adonis. Now a rather talented swordsman from one of the top training schools, when Adonis is captured by a demon to save his life, he sets out on a quest to save Adonis.
